Assuming that x0 − x? is an arbitrary starting vector and that (9) holds, we have that each term in this summation is smaller for the without-replacement sampling model than for the with-replacement sampling model. In turn, we expect the without-replacement sampling implementation will return lower risk after one pass over the data-set. Similarly, for the randomized Kaczmarz iteration (7), Conjecture 1 implies that a without-replacement sample will have lower error after k < n iterations.
